title: Capacitor integrator
description: Uses Capacitor.integrate_current with dt=1/fs. Output sample k is voltage AFTER interval k; first sample includes one integration step. Without leakage: V+=I dt/C. With leakage: Vnew=Vold exp(−dt/RC)+IR(1−exp(−dt/RC)). No kT/C reset noise.

params.name: initial_V
params.description: Initial voltage; resets at start of every run.

params.name: leakage_enabled
params.description: Use finite RC leakage; deterministic even with noise off.

params.name: leakage_ohm
params.description: Leakage resistance; exact constant-current RC solution per sample.
